opencode-setup-guide.title: Prepare OpenCode SDK
opencode-setup-guide.intro: Fix the provider and model, then prepare a new configuration on the execution node. Copying a command does not execute it.
opencode-setup-guide.runtime_versions: Use the reviewed OpenCode SDK/server 1.19.4 and complete suma-opencode-runtime package. This fixed baseline is not an observation of the installed CLI version.
opencode-setup-guide.paths_help: Use reviewed native executables and the manifest from one complete SDK package. The bundle is derived from that package; the Runner validates the actual files and dependencies.
opencode-setup-guide.credential_help: Enter an existing, separate environment variable name on the execution node, never its secret value. Leave it empty only when the provider needs no credential.
opencode-setup-guide.new_file_help: Choose a new path outside the SDK package in an existing directory. The command never overwrites a file and creates only opencode-coder with no check references. Administrators can later add real test commands through the full configuration.
opencode-setup-guide.incomplete: Complete the fixed provider, model and URL, then choose the shell and valid machine paths to prepare a new file.
opencode-setup-guide.prepare_title: Create a new configuration on the node
opencode-setup-guide.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select and copy the displayed command manually.
opencode-setup-guide.boundary: Run the command explicitly on the target machine, then continue with the same node to read or report actual inventory. Preparation does not install tools, sign in, verify a model or create tasks. Registration stays paused until separately enabled; empty checks do not mean tests passed. Usage remains observe-only.
